Implemented the released deep-codebook, depth-calibrated UBTree selector.
Implemented the paper's width-12 frontier and prefix-closed global pruning.
Projected the checkpoint B64 tree to the current AST tile's B15 non-root budget.
Added a correctness-first exact serial target-tree executor for mixed KV and recurrent state.
Added strict artifact topology, tensor-header, payload-revision, and role checks.
Select the shared external serving backend when UBTree is bound; preserve ordinary decoding otherwise.
Preserve cumulative-score publication order (already parent-first under nonpositive depth bonus), so AST adaptive-budget counterfactuals refer to actual smaller-budget trees.
